newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian man says wife cut penis by mistake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian man says wife cut penis by mistake.

text.p: A Malaysian man whose wife severed his penis while he slept said she made the cut accidentally while dreaming of strangling him, the national Bernama news agency reported on Tuesday.

Hassan Abdullah, 41, recovering in a hospital in Malaysia's eastern Kelantan state, said he would not take legal action against his wife because it was an accident, Bernama reported. It did not give the wife's name.
"When I woke up I called my wife but she was quiet," Hassan, a food seller, said of the incident early Friday morning.
He said that only after calling her name several times did she wake up and tell him she had dreamt of strangling him.
Hassan said he then realised his wife had cut him with a knife while she dreamt, but did not explain why she wanted to strangle him or how the dream could have led her to sever his penis.
He also denied that they had marital problems, saying they had been married 21 years and have four children.
Hassan said he expected to live a "healthy and normal life" after doctors took four hours to re-attach the severed penis.
